source.citation: Akhtyamova and Travkin (2023), Investigation of Frontal Zones in the Norwegian Sea, Physical Oceanography 30(1), 62-77.
source.license_statement: CC BY-NC 4.0 on PDF page 1; original not redistributed.
source.reviewed_scope: Selected extracted text: title, sections 2-3, Norwegian Coastal Current frontal-zone paragraph on PDF page 8 / printed page 69.

classification.feature: thermohaline frontal zone associated with the Norwegian Coastal Current
classification.relationship_to_current: associated proxy, not identity or dimension equivalence
classification.basis: GLORYS12V1 reanalysis, January 1993-December 2019, seasonal averaging before property-gradient detection.

reported_proxy_metrics.field_scope: Thermohaline frontal zone; not a velocity-defined current axis.
Salinity field in some areas; not whole-current width.

decision: Retain as a proxy-context lead. Do not promote frontal-zone dimensions, Norway coastline lengths or their seasonal changes into current length/width ranks or annual margins.
next_gate: Recover original custody and visually confirm source pages before any separate proxy-context admission. A current dimension still needs a current-specific axis or velocity-edge method.
